question: Which companies are on more than 5 deals?
draft_sql: SELECT c.name FROM company c JOIN deal_party dp ON c.id = dp.company_id GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(dp.deal_id) > 5;
final_sql:
SELECT c.name,COUNT(DISTINCT dp.deal_id)
FROM company c
JOIN deal_party dp ON c.id = dp.company_id
JOIN deal d        ON dp.deal_id = d.id
WHERE d.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'AGREED', 'ON_HOLD', 'SHIPPED', 'NEGOTIATING', 'LEAD')
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dp.deal_id) > 5;

question: What is the total value of open deals in each currency?
draft_sql: SELECT r.name AS currency_name, COALESCE(SUM(dp.value), 0) AS total_value FROM deal d JOIN deal_party dp ON d.id = dp.deal_id JOIN reference_item r ON dp.currency_id = r.id WHERE d.status IN ('LEAD', 'NEGOTIATING', 'AGREED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'SHIPPED') GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY r.name;
final_sql:
SELECT r.name                      AS currency_name,
       COALESCE(SUM(dp.value), 0)  AS total_value
FROM deal d
JOIN deal_party dp    ON dp.deal_id = d.id
JOIN reference_item r ON r.id = d.currency_id
WHERE d.status IN ('LEAD', 'NEGOTIATING', 'AGREED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'SHIPPED')
GROUP BY r.id, r.name
ORDER BY r.name;

question: Which owners have more than 10 milestones that were planned before 15 September 2026 and are not done?
draft_sql: SELECT dp.owner_user_id AS owner_id, COUNT(dm.id) AS milestone_count FROM deal_milestone dm JOIN deal_party dp ON dm.deal_id = dp.deal_id WHERE dm.planned_date < '2026-09-15' AND dm.status != 'DONE' GROUP BY dp.owner_user_id HAVING COUNT(dm.id) > 10;
final_sql:
SELECT u.name                                     AS owner_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT dm.id)                      AS milestone_count,
       STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.name, ', ' ORDER BY c.name) AS companies
FROM deal_milestone dm
JOIN deal d        ON d.id = dm.deal_id
JOIN app_user u    ON u.id = d.owner_user_id
JOIN deal_party dp ON dp.deal_id = d.id
JOIN company c     ON c.id = dp.company_id
WHERE dm.planned_date < DATE '2026-09-15'
  AND dm.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'DONE'
GROUP BY u.id, u.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dm.id) > 10;
notes: Yea so the correction given is better to an extent but like exact thing user might want can't be attained through single query and so a list of the companies for the milestones would be great.

question: Which processes are offered by more than two companies?
draft_sql: SELECT r.name AS process_name FROM company_process cp JOIN reference_item r ON cp.process_id = r.id GROUP BY r.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cp.company_id) > 2;
final_sql:
SELECT r.name AS process_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cp.company_id) AS company_count,
       STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.name, ', ' ORDER BY c.name) AS companies
FROM company_process cp
JOIN reference_item r ON cp.process_id = r.id
JOIN company c        ON cp.company_id = c.id
GROUP BY r.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cp.company_id) > 2
ORDER BY company_count DESC;
notes: The output given was correct but like always user might expect informative and so the companies with the process names might also be helpful.

question: How many deals does each owner have?
draft_sql: SELECT d.owner_user_id, COUNT(d.id) AS deal_count FROM deal d GROUP BY d.owner_user_id;
final_sql:
SELECT au.name          AS owner_name,
       au.id            AS owner_user_id,
       COUNT(d.id)      AS deal_count
FROM deal d
JOIN app_user au ON au.id = d.owner_user_id
GROUP BY au.id, au.name
ORDER BY deal_count DESC;
notes: Users will prefer to see name over id on any request but id is also fine to return as we need it for refernecing.

final_sql: SELECT c.name AS company_name, COALESCE(SUM(dp.commission_amount), 0) AS total_commission_received FROM company c JOIN deal_party dp ON c.id = dp.company_id WHERE dp.commission_status = 'RECEIVED' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_commission_received DESC;

question: Which currencies have more than 500,000 of open deal value?

final_sql: SELECT r.name AS currency_name, SUM(dp.value) FROM reference_item r JOIN deal d ON r.id = d.currency_id JOIN deal_party dp ON d.id = dp.deal_id WHERE d.status IN ('LEAD', 'NEGOTIATING', 'AGREED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'SHIPPED') AND dp.role = 'BUYER' GROUP BY r.name HAVING SUM(dp.value) > 500000;

question: Which certified companies are not on any open deal?
draft_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.name FROM company c JOIN company_certification cc ON c.id = cc.company_id LEFT JOIN deal d ON c.id = ANY(STRING_TO_ARRAY(d.deal_parties, ',')) WHERE d.status NOT IN ('LEAD', 'NEGOTIATING', 'AGREED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'SHIPPED') OR d IS NULL;
final_sql:
SELECT c.id, c.name
FROM company c
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM company_certification cc WHERE cc.company_id = c.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM deal_party dp
    JOIN deal d ON d.id = dp.deal_id
    WHERE dp.company_id = c.id
      AND d.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'COMPLETED'
  );

question: Change the commission rate on Ludhiana Spinners' leg of DL-2026-0019 to 2%, and update the commission amount to match.
draft_sql: WITH deal_info AS ( SELECT dp.id AS deal_party_id FROM deal d JOIN deal_party dp ON d.id = dp.deal_id JOIN company c ON dp.company_id = c.id WHERE d.deal_no = 'DL-2026-0019' AND c.name ILIKE '%Ludhiana Spinners%' ), update_commission AS ( UPDATE deal_party SET commission_pct = 0.02, commission_amount = dp.value * 0.02 WHERE id = (SELECT deal_party_id FROM deal_info) ) SELECT (SELECT dp.commission_amount FROM deal_party dp JOIN (SELECT deal_party_id FROM deal_info) sub ON dp.id = sub.deal_party_id) AS updated_commission_amount;
final_sql:
UPDATE deal_party
SET commission_pct    = 0.02,
    commission_amount = value * 0.02
WHERE deal_id IN (SELECT id FROM deal WHERE deal_no = 'DL-2026-0019')
  AND company_id IN (SELECT id FROM company WHERE name ILIKE '%Ludhiana Spinners%')
RETURNING id, company_id, value, commission_pct, commission_amount;
